name: College Love Triangles
source:
College Love Triangles revolves around a group of friends, most just starting their freshman year at college, and the complex love/lust triangles they will all face.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/lordpercygames/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《大学三角恋》围绕一群朋友展开，其中大多数人刚刚开始大学一年级，他们都将面临复杂的爱情/欲望三角关系。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/lordpercygames/about]Patreon[/url]]
